detail.longDescription: Published v5.0.0 for my CapacitorJS plugin 'capacitor-statusbar-safe-area' Repo👉 https:// github.com/Aashu-Dubey/capacit or-statusbar-safe-area Release notes: - Support for Capacitor v8 (very late 😅) - Android: using androidx Compat APIs for better backward compatibility and reducing API conditional logic. - Android: getStatusBarHeight() now resolves with { height: 0 } instead of returning null when no height value is available, aligning Android with iOS and Web behavior. # opensource # github # android # iOS
